If the agents are trained to optimize for throughput, they might prioritize GPUs with higher performance. Thoroughness tradeoffs. The system needs to balance between processing more requests and maintaining performance. If the agent is trying to maximize throughput, they might use more workers, but that could lead to higher latency. Conversely, if the agent focuses on minimizing latency, they might use fewer workers, leading to lower throughput. This trade-off is crucial for the overall system performance.
